source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 526 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-526.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 526 was established by Ordinance No. 23734, passed by the Dallas City Council on December 9, 1998. Ordinance No. 23734 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 23734; 25164)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-526.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 526 is established on property generally located west of the intersection of Park Lane and Greenville Avenue. The size of PD 526 is approximately 7.039 acres. (Ord. Nos. 23734; 25164; 25353)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-526.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all code references are to Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a nonresidential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 23734; 25164)

sections.title: Development And Landscape Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-526.104. DEVELOPMENT AND LANDSCAPE PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the development and landscape plan (Exhibit 526A). The city plan commission must approve a new development and landscape plan reducing the required off-street parking spaces prior to the issuance of any additional building permits authorizing work in this district. In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the development and landscape plan, the provisions of this article control. (Ord. Nos. 23734; 25164; 25353)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-526.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Transit passenger station or transfer center.

(b) Except as provided in Subsection (a), the uses permitted in this district are all uses permitted in the MU-3 Mixed Use District, as amended, subject to the same conditions applicable in the MU-3 Mixed Use District, as set out in the Dallas Development Code, as amended. For example, a use permitted in the MU-3 Mixed Use District by specific use permit (SUP) only is permitted in this planned development district by SUP. A use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the MU-3 Mixed Use District is subject to DIR in this planned development district, etc. (Ord. Nos. 23734; 25164)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-526.106. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to

additional regulations contained in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217.

(b) The following accessory use is not permitted in this district:

-- Private stable.

(c) The following accessory use is permitted by SUP only:

-- Accessory medical/infectious waste incinerator. (Ord. Nos. 23734; 25164)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-526.107. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(a) Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations of the MU-3 Mixed Use District, contained in Section 51A-4.125(f)(4), apply.

(b) For the transit passenger station or transfer center use, minimum front, side, and rear yards are as shown on the development and landscape plan. (Ord. Nos. 23734; 25164)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-526.108. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) For the transit passenger station or transfer center use, a minimum of 300 off-street parking spaces must be provided on the Property as shown on the development and landscape plan.

(b) For all other permitted uses, consult the use regulations contained in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use. Consult the off-street parking and loading regulations (Divisions 51A-4.300 et seq.) for information regarding off-street parking and loading generally. (Ord. Nos. 23734; 25164; 25353)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-526.109. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 23734; 25164)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-526.110. LANDSCAPING.

Landscaping must comply with the development and landscape plan and be installed in accordance with Article X. All plant material specified on the development and landscape plan must comply with the size, type, and species contained in Article X. Plant material must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. Tree mitigation requirements must be met as outlined in Article X. (Ord. Nos. 23734; 25164)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-526.111. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 23734; 25164)

sections.title: Access
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-526.112. ACCESS.

Ingress and egress must be provided as shown on the development and landscape plan. (Ord. Nos. 23734; 25164)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-526.113. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23734; 25164; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-526.114. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this planned development district until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23734; 25164; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-526.115. ZONING MAP.

PD 526 is located on Zoning Map No. F-8. (Ord. Nos. 23734; 25164)
